create_make_iterated_matrix_game: create an iterated matrix game environment with specified iterations and batch size using pyspiel and open_spiel
build_make_agent_networks: build Haiku policy and value function networks for an agent with a given number of actions
run_agents: run multiple OpponentShapingAgent instances in an open_spiel environment for a specified number of steps
test_lola_policy_gradient: test the Lola correction type of OpponentShapingAgent in a repeated matrix game environment
test_dice_policy_gradient: test the Dice correction type of OpponentShapingAgent with multiple lookaheads in a repeated matrix game
